architecture.approach: Next.js App Router client pages read discovery and registration data from Convex through thin hooks. Convex owns discovery queries, registration state, QR generation, and ownership checks; Clerk supplies the identity resolved by secureQuery/secureMutation.

components.name: app/(public)/explore/page.tsx
components.description: Aggregates featured, nearby, popular events and category counts.

components.name: app/(public)/explore/[slug]/page.tsx
components.description: Resolves category and location slugs with pagination.

components.name: app/(public)/events/[slug]/page.tsx
components.description: Public event detail and call-to-action states.

components.name: app/(main)/my-tickets/page.tsx
components.description: Upcoming and past tickets, QR dialog, cancellation.

components.name: convex/explore.ts
components.description: Featured, location, category, popular, and count queries.

components.name: convex/search.ts
components.description: Title search over the search_title index.

components.name: convex/registrations.ts
components.description: Register, check, list, cancel, attendee list, check-in.

components.name: convex/users.ts
components.description: Current user, store, and onboarding completion.

components.name: lib/location-utils.ts
components.description: Builds and parses city-state location slugs.

dataModel.flowDescription: Explore queries feed public cards; an event slug resolves a detail page; registration authenticates through Clerk, writes a registration with a generated QR code, and increments the event count; My Tickets lists registrations and renders the QR; cancellation flips status and decrements the count.

securityConsiderations.description: Registration and cancellation resolve the user from the Clerk token and check ownership in Convex; the organizer attendee list also checks organizerId.
Name and email are required by the form and constrained by the Convex mutation validators.

performanceConsiderations.strategy: Discovery queries take a bounded window before sorting, and category/location pages return ten records per page.

risks.description: Capacity could be oversold by concurrent registrations.
risks.mitigation: The mutation re-reads the event and re-checks capacity inside the transaction.
Category and location routes remain the primary browse paths.
